mechanism: exact group homomorphism U(m)->Fock unitaries restricted to the monomial subgroup (permutation x powers of i), with integer Z4 phase arithmetic and token-swapping resynthesis on grid edges

rule.name: physical_monomial_passive_prefix_resynthesis
rule.idea: At the physical stage, collect the leading DAG-commuting prefix of passive gates (R with quarter-turn phase, BS with half/quarter-turn angle and quarter-turn phase) on qumode wires: these are exactly the monomial elements of U(m), a closed subgroup (permutation times powers of i per mode). Compose the block's action with pure integer Z4 phase/permutation arithmetic (cross-checked against the dense complex mode matrix), factor the resulting permutation into transpositions along coupled grid edges via BFS, emit one BS(pi,0) per transposition plus residual R(q*pi/2) phases, and replace the block only if the recomputed (permutation, phase) matches exactly and the gate cost is lower. Because U(M) is determined by M alone (fixes vacuum, no phase ambiguity) and M1->U(M1), M2->U(M2) compose as U(M1)U(M2)=U(M2 M1), equality of M implies operator equality on the whole Fock space, so the swap is exact on every cutoff.
